title: Turkey teriyaki bowl
summary: Turkey teriyaki bowl is a japanese dinner built around turkey breast steaks and mangetout, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice turkey breast steaks and mangetout before the pan is hot. Turkey teriyaki bowl is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry turkey breast steaks until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add mangetout and carrots, return turkey breast steaks, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Turkey teriyaki bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
